class Solution:
    def rotate(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> None:
        n = len(nums)
        k %= n
        count = 0
        start = 0
        while count < n:
            pre = nums[start]
            cur = start
            while True:
                nxt = (cur + k) % n
                nums[nxt], pre = pre, nums[nxt]
                cur = nxt
                count += 1
                if cur == start:
                    break
            start += 1
